integrity: Exact proof via a fully specified finite carry graph and Cayley–Hamilton order bound; standalone script independently checks the graph and 729 polynomial coefficients.
scientific_limitations: Only the central four-term coefficient sequence modulo three at complete ternary-power index cutoffs; no modulo-nine or arbitrary-cutoff theorem. General automaton techniques could encode equivalent prior content. Independent review has not occurred.
title: Exact ternary residue census and a sharp bias for central quadrinomial coefficients
